prompt:
Summarize the merged change below in at most two sentences for a changelog: what changed, then why. Name the pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the change text. Also name the ticket OMN-19514.

--- change 1 (repo omnimarket, pull request #2884) ---
feat(OMN-19514): delegation_events carries the ticket its terminal carried (#2884)
* feat(OMN-19514): delegation_events carries the ticket its terminal carried

Consumer half of the decision-workflow eval plan Task 4: a delegation run is
joined to the ticket it worked, so a DoD verdict for that ticket can be joined
to the delegated attempt it judged.

- migration 0047 adds nullable delegation_events.ticket_id plus a partial index
- the terminal projection model accepts ticket_id (raw JSON value; a malformed
  one never dead-letters the row)
- a pure fold (HandlerDelegationTicketFold) returns the column for a
  well-formed ticket, nothing for an absent one, and a named refusal for a
  malformed one; both effect writers persist what it returns
- the delegate-skill response decodes a ticket_id key before it declares it
  (step 1 of the consumer-first order the wire compatibility gate enforces);
  step 2 declares it and the handler copies the request ticket onto the
  terminal once a release carries this
- ticket_id is annotated in the projection exposure allowlist as a
  server-side join key
- carries the post-release 0.4.217 bump, byte-identical to omnimarket#2874,
  so the release-identity gate passes; whichever lands first, the other's
  copy merges as a no-op
